app_fee.value: KRW 130,000 (or USD 130 if paid via PayPal) for Master's, Ph.D., and Integrated M.S.-Ph.D. applicants on the International Student Track.
app_fee.quote: Application Fee | Admission Track | Master / Ph. D / Integrated Notice | 130,000 KRW

fee_waiver.value: The Graduate School Admission Guideline for International Students states that the KRW 130,000 application fee is non-refundable once paid and does not offer an application fee waiver for international applicants.
fee_waiver.quote: Applications CANNOT be CANCELED, REPLACED (submitted documents) or CHANGED (applying information) once paying the application fee, and the fee is non-refundable.

gre_general.value: The Graduate School Admission Guideline for International Students lists required application documents and language proficiency tests without stating a GRE General requirement.

toefl_min.value: Most STEM departments require TOEFL iBT 3.5 on the post-January 21, 2026 1-6 scale (59 on the prior 0-120 scale); Electrical and Electronic Engineering, Industrial Engineering, and Medical Sciences (BK21 Project) require 4.0 (72).
toefl_min.quote: 3) In accordance with the changes to the TOEFL iBT scoring system, applicants who took the TOEFL iBT before January 21, 2026, may submit scores that meet or exceed the minimum TOEFL score indicated in parentheses | Physics Lv. 3 O 3.5(59) 750 285 5.5 O

ielts_min.value: Most STEM departments require IELTS Academic 5.5 minimum; Electrical and Electronic Engineering, Industrial Engineering, and Medical Sciences (BK21 Project) require IELTS 6.0.
ielts_min.quote: Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering Lv. 3 O 3.5(59) 750 285 5.5 O | Electrical and Electronic Engineering Lv. 3 O 4.0(72) 750 285 6.0 O

english_waiver.value: All STEM departments permit substitution ('O') of the English proficiency test if the applicant completed all curriculum of a Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. degree program in English (either in an English-speaking country or in a non-English-speaking country such as India, documented by an official certificate with the university seal).

notes: QS WUR 2027 #42. Covers all 18 STEM PhD fields through Yonsei University Graduate School (Sinchon/Seoul Campus and Songdo International Campus). International Student Track offers two admissions cycles per year: Spring 2027 online application ran October 7-14, 2026, and Fall 2027 online application runs April 6-13, 2027. Full-time international students in non-Medical/Dental/Nursing Graduate School departments automatically receive the Yonsei International Companion Scholarship (KRW 3,000,000/semester for 4 semesters in Ph.D.; KRW 2,000,000/semester for 6 semesters in Integrated M.S.-Ph.D.) unless receiving a full-tuition scholarship; competitive full-tuition Graduate Student Assistantships, Yonsei Graduate Fellowships (up to KRW 7.5M), BK21 Four scholarships, and Global Korea Scholarships (GKS) are also available.
